title: Hearty Hungover Tunisian Goose Tagine
description: A sour and light Tunisian dish featuring goose fat and nuka-pickle to help cure hangovers, this recipe is nut-free-friendly and perfect for a morning pick-me-up. It combines the richness of goose with the tanginess of pickled vegetables.
instructions: Heat the goose fat in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the chopped nuka-pickle, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the tagine for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional lemon wedges if desired.
Let the tagine cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
